title: kernel-v1 fuzz & property-test bounds (v1)
description: Versioned source of truth for the numeric constants that bound fuzzing and property testing of the parser/decoder boundaries (event-abi ABI decode, rules YAML/regex parse, protocol protobuf-shaped deserialize, storage-local SQLCipher open). Every fuzz harness and proptest module references these defaults rather than hardcoding numbers inline; any fuzz bound not anchored here is a plan defect. max_input_size caps the byte length fed to a single fuzz iteration (libfuzzer -max_len); max_nesting_depth caps condition/expression nesting constructed by structured fuzzers; max_regex_chars caps regex pattern length assembled by the rules regex-boundary fuzzer; corpus_size is the default number of generated cases a property test or seed corpus targets. The defaults mirror the production budgets they defend: max_input_size defaults to 65536 (64 KiB), max_nesting_depth to 16 (matches rule-budget max_nested_expressions), max_regex_chars to 256 (matches rule-budget max_regex_chars), corpus_size to 1000.

max_input_size.description: Maximum number of bytes fed to a single fuzz iteration (the libfuzzer `-max_len` value). Inputs larger than this are out of scope for the parser boundaries; the default 65536 (64 KiB) comfortably exceeds the event-abi record ceiling (HEADER_LEN 96 + PAYLOAD_MAX 4096) and the protocol max message size headroom while keeping fuzz iterations cheap.

max_nesting_depth.description: Maximum AND/OR/NOT condition nesting depth a structured fuzzer may construct (rules deep-nesting target) and the depth a property test treats as in-bounds. Mirrors rule-budget.v1.json max_nested_expressions default (16); a deeper constructed condition must be rejected with a typed NestingTooDeep error, never a stack overflow.

max_regex_chars.description: Maximum number of characters in a regex pattern assembled by the rules regex-boundary fuzzer and treated as in-bounds by property tests. Mirrors rule-budget.v1.json max_regex_chars default (256); a longer or catastrophically-backtracking pattern must be rejected with a typed RegexTooLarge/RegexTooComplex error, never hang.

corpus_size.description: Default number of generated cases a property test (proptest cases) or seed corpus targets per boundary. Bench/CI harnesses read this default; the value is NOT hardcoded in the harness scripts. Individual proptest! blocks may override via ProptestConfig, but the anchored default is the reference corpus size.

max_record_len.description: Maximum event-abi record length (HEADER_LEN 96 + PAYLOAD_MAX 4096) the ABI roundtrip property treats as a well-formed in-bounds record. Anchored here so the event-abi proptest/fuzz bound is not hardcoded; a record_len above this is out of the v1 wire contract.

max_message_size_bytes.description: Maximum serialized protocol message size (1 MiB) the protocol bounds fuzzer treats as in-bounds. Mirrors protocol.v1.json / MessageBounds::default max_message_size_bytes; an oversized deserialized batch must be rejected with a typed OversizedMessage/OversizedBatch error.
